obligations.summary: Equal digest values remain logically isolated across typed partitions, and removal authority does not cross partition boundaries.
A staged blob is invisible to both read and physicalID until its stage is explicitly published.
Publish has one terminal transition; duplicate publish of the same stage fails with transactionConflict while the first publication remains readable.
Discard is idempotent and terminal; a discarded stage cannot later publish and never becomes logically readable.
A duplicate verified commit in one partition reuses the same physical blob and reports the created-to-reused disposition transition.
Equal digest values committed in different partitions remain physically distinct and each publication reports creation.
The store independently recomputes digest integrity before publication and leaves no physical authority after a mismatch.
remove and removeAll revoke only their targeted logical authority while preserving unrelated digest and partition visibility.
Bounded garbage collection retains exactly the declared live references and reports the removed blob and byte totals.
Successfully published bytes survive release of the store instance and a clean reopen of the same storage root.
A store generation is stable for one compatibility fingerprint and changes identity when the compatibility fingerprint changes.
Only one active writer may own a store root; a conflicting open fails with transactionConflict and release permits a later reopen.
